mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2.5% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during periods with FEDFUNDS < 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.2% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month, a tightening labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window with UNRATE < 4.2% and PAYEMS growth > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 115 signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST exceeding 10% YoY signals a housing market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window with HOUST YoY growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase by more than 0.5% in a single month, a monetary tightening cycle signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with joint FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to the general labor market's influence on consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods with low UNRATE (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $400k and GDPC1 growth is positive, a consumption-driven demand boost signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window with RSAFS > $400k and positive GDPC1 growth.
